messages.aux.skill.android-dev: Build, run, inspect, and lightly automate Android apps through the android-emulator MCP tools.
messages.aux.skill.brainstorming: Use before any creative work, including creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements, and design before implementation.
messages.aux.skill.control-browser: Control ZAICODE's built-in browser to open, inspect, click, type, screenshot, or verify webpages and local development targets.
messages.aux.skill.dispatching-parallel-agents: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies.
messages.aux.skill.docx: Create, edit, and analyze DOCX documents with revisions, comments, formatting preservation, and text extraction. Use for new documents, edits, revision handling, comments, and professional Word document work.
messages.aux.skill.dynamic-workflows: Use when writing, debugging, or resubmitting a dynamic-workflow script for CreateWorkflow: choosing subagent topology, typing subagent results, fanning out over files or git, gating loops on world.run commands, testing pieces with EvalWorkflowSnippet, planner-reviewer loops, report() salvage, publishing artifacts the user opens, and handling a backgrounded run.
messages.aux.skill.executing-plans: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints.
messages.aux.skill.finishing-a-development-branch: Use when implementation is complete, tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work through merge, PR, or cleanup.
messages.aux.skill.ios-dev: Build, run, inspect, and lightly automate iOS Simulator apps through the ios-simulator MCP tools.
messages.aux.skill.pdf: Professional PDF toolkit for reports, creative visuals, academic LaTeX, and existing-PDF workflows. Supports reports, posters, papers, resumes, extraction, merge, split, forms, and conversion.
messages.aux.skill.pptx: Inspect and narrowly update elements selected in PPTX Preview Pane. Verifies the whole-file fingerprint and OOXML locator for shape or table-cell text, and stops on conflicts instead of guessing.
messages.aux.skill.receiving-code-review: Use when receiving code review feedback before implementing suggestions, especially when feedback is unclear or technically questionable.
messages.aux.skill.requesting-code-review: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements.
messages.aux.skill.plugin-creator: Create and validate ZAICODE plugins, and guide local installation and updates.
messages.aux.skill.skill-creator: Create new skills, edit existing skills, and iterate wording. Use for writing SKILL.md from scratch, improving skills, capturing repeated workflows, or tuning descriptions for reliable triggering.
messages.aux.skill.subagent-driven-development: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session.
messages.aux.skill.systematic-debugging: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes.
messages.aux.skill.test-driven-development: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code.
messages.aux.skill.using-git-worktrees: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation or before executing implementation plans. Ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback.
messages.aux.skill.using-superpowers: Use when starting any conversation. Establishes how to find and use skills, requiring Skill tool invocation before any response including clarifying questions.
messages.aux.skill.verification-before-completion: Use before claiming work is complete, fixed, or passing. Requires running verification commands and confirming output before success claims.
messages.aux.skill.web-gui-tester: Run pure GUI black-box tests against websites and local web frontends with ZAICODE Browser Use, combining real user interactions, semantic DOM evidence, and inspected screenshots.
messages.aux.skill.writing-plans: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code.
messages.aux.skill.writing-skills: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment.
